name: frontend-installer
body: A person who installs the apg binary plus one or more language frontend formulae (or the `curl | sh` Linux packages) and then runs `apg scan` on a repository. They need to know which language toolchains must be on PATH (`go`, `cargo`/`rustc`, `java`, `node`) and, when one is missing, to receive an actionable error naming the toolchain instead of a cryptic failure or a silently empty scan.
